bearing_on_endpoint: The judges' low visual_necessity scores are consistent with the item text on direct reading, so the round-4 null is not evidence of judge miscalibration; it reflects item construction plus corpus redundancy.
finding: About a third of gate-passing items ask about the TEXT ('theo văn bản') inside a frame selected for image-necessity. The ECM contract constrains the declared evidence tuple but does not constrain question CONTENT toward visual dependence, so text-directed items pass the gate in every arm including ecm_full.

superseded_metric.earlier_claim: 70% of answers appear verbatim in T_c
superseded_metric.why_wrong: bare substring test; e.g. a short answer matched incidentally inside a longer institution name, which is not the survey result the question asks about

what_this_is: Single-rater, non-blinded, post-hoc reading of the 50 gate-passing round-4 items by the assistant. It is NOT the pre-registered human semantic review and carries no confirmatory weight.
